description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
rules: Install with npm install -g @multi-agent/cli. Multi-Agent requires Node.js 22 or 24, tmux, and Claude Code or Codex signed in. The starter team uses both, and the kernel operator adapts it when you have only one.
Preview before launching: multi-agent specs preview <spec>, then multi-agent up <spec> --cwd . --plan, then multi-agent up <spec> --cwd .
Check seat readiness with multi-agent ps --nodes --rig <rig>, not only daemon health from multi-agent status.
Inside a rig, an agent runs multi-agent whoami --json first and treats its output as its identity.
multi-agent send <session> "message" types into a peer's terminal and presses Enter; multi-agent capture <session> reads that peer's screen.
Work another agent must act on goes in the queue (multi-agent queue create or multi-agent queue handoff); a message informs but does not assign work.
Use multi-agent start to bring rigs back after a reboot or daemon restart.
Run multi-agent --help for the current command surface; the CLI is authoritative over older examples.
